correctness.rationale: For a cycle with n>=3 strictly positive lengths a_i, the n signed normalized edge vectors span the dimension n-1 rooted zero-sum edge space and have sole circuit relation sum a_i v_i=0. Generic facet cones are indexed by one omitted edge and signs satisfying |sum_{j!=i}sigma_j a_j|<a_i; determinants are 1/prod_{j!=i}a_j. Every resonance is recovered by continuous symmetric perturbation of finite sign equalities, giving exactly 1/2 boundary weights even at multiple ties. Polar rooted increments form a box clipped by sum u_i, whose density at zero is the inclusion-exclusion truncated-power formula. Uniform weights reduce via balanced binomial count; a local central limit theorem plus central binomial asymptotic gives normalized 2sqrt(3)/pi. Independently calculated unit-cycle primal and polar exact rational volumes n=3..7 and inspected rational-hull verification source. Finite hull checks do not establish generic-to-resonant or asymptotic statements; analytic proof does.
residual_risks: Finite verification does not prove all quantified real/dimensional claims; the proof was independently reconstructed and checked against boundary cases.
